list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all 55). Guides are this entry's own words; sources are named beside each guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: This one pops by itself once the other 54 are done. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the roadmap in order, clear the 100% checklist last, and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end. It unlocks in normal story play and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Nothing extra is needed: the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 the same way. Note that once Chapter 2 opens you can play as both Jason and Lucia, which is what makes the later meditation spots possible.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only, nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only, nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida, so everything after this point — cleanup, collectibles, the 100% checklist — stays open.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. No special approach is needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in the story. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in the story. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in the story. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in the story. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in the story. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist in the Progress menu (it appears in full after the story, though earlier progress already counts) and clear every line on it: story, strangers, collectibles, activities and robberies. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and puts the platinum near 200 hours, most of it here; Push Square warns to set aside up to 300 hours. Use the checklist, not your trophy count, as the source of truth.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida: jumps, near misses and airtime all feed the counter. GTA Zone reports 397 stunts exist and 300 count toward 100%, so you have slack — spread it across free roam instead of grinding one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The game counts a type the first time you play it, so sample everything — races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, the shooting range and drone races — rather than mastering one first.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges (GTA Zone). Practise one weapon class at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback; gold thresholds are per challenge, so a weak weapon never blocks the rest.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; PowerPyx counts 42 races in total across them. Learn one track per location — winning once per location is enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Work through the race list and tick each new win off here.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges run from the fishing spots; bring the best rod and tackle you have and play the reeling patiently instead of rushing it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to its end. Any arcade cabinet counts; pick the shortest game you enjoy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to his final mission and finish it. Side strands unlock as the story progresses; check the map for Andy's marker between story missions.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission and finish it, the same pattern as Andy's.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's strand to its final mission and finish it, the same pattern as Andy's and Kenton's.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Not every stranger counts: GTA Zone reports Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are among the qualifying strands, while Andy, Billy, Tyrone and Yasmani have their own trophies and do not count here — so prioritise the unaffiliated strangers you meet around Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's strand to its final mission and finish it, the same pattern as the other side characters.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's strand to its final mission and finish it, the same pattern as the other side characters.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots: 10 locations, most counting twice, once per character. Track it at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE WARNING (PowerPyx): the first meditation, at Jason's house, is only available in Chapter 1 — after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that spot is required for the trophy, but do it anyway; it costs nothing. The last spot (Ascent, Mount Kalaga) only appears on the map after the other 17. Only 15 of 18 are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks about and bring it down. The hunt runs as a stranger strand: follow Bret's markers and use a scoped rifle so you do not spook it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set only counts when every card in it is collected, so track sets, not single cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. GTA Zone breaks the pool down into landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags — photograph anything the WAiNK prompt appears for and the counter climbs.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through activities and free roam; the counter is cumulative, so keep playing varied activities and it fills on its own.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Open ground with a fast car nearby works best: get the heat, break line of sight, then drive clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the streak breaks if the heat drops, so keep moving and keep the level alive between shops. Plan a route of three close shops first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: drive or ride anything new and the game logs it. Vary how you travel — traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles all count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Pick a crowded fight, wait for a group to cluster, then trigger Focus and work through them quickly.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, leave by an unscheduled route — the description's joke is the method: do not use the front door. Find a runway or service exit and get out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed a method for this one yet. The description hints at Rhinos (tanks) and heat, so it likely involves tanks, but do not grind on a guess — check PowerPyx's guide for an update before spending time on it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official list; PowerPyx (no confirmed method yet)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and retry.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; GTA Zone reports 8 vaults exist, and all 8 are needed for 100%. Vault jobs open with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring a 4-star response, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes; hit one away from heavy police presence and break away fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: the map's fog must clear everywhere, across all 52 areas (GTAVice target). Flying is the fastest way to sweep the dark patches left on the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (GTABase via EGamers; GTAVice target 9). One per gang is enough for the trophy; all 39 operations are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: go to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. The description is the whole method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: follow through a full game there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the description names no place, person or number, and no published guide has confirmed a method yet. Do not chase guesses; check PowerPyx for an update before spending time on it.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official list; PowerPyx (no confirmed method yet)

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the description gives no target. PlayStation tracks a running count for this trophy, but no published guide has confirmed the exact number or what counts as a choice yet. Play normally and check the counter rather than forcing choices.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official list; KeenGamer (method still being confirmed)

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the wording suggests succeeding after a failure, but no published guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Do not force failures on a guess; check PowerPyx for an update.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official list; PowerPyx (no confirmed method yet)

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the description is a riddle by design, and KeenGamer lists this among the hidden trophies with an unconfirmed method. It likely involves a strange random event in Leonida — keep playing and check the guides rather than hunting blind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PARTLY CONFIRMED: bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so take the description literally and verify in PowerPyx if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). The total is cumulative and builds up during the robberies on the 100% checklist; GTABase notes one fence pays best.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. It accumulates through normal play — weapons, clothes, food — so do not force it early; check the total late in cleanup.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app (about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count). The app unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: drive a vehicle, open the app and register it, then repeat with nine more different vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
